svg.title: Midrolo architecture
svg.desc: Midrolo's high level design: browsers reach a Rails 8.1 app through Cloudflare and Traefik. The web process serves pages; a Solid Queue worker runs the brand fit search, the sponsor report agent, catalog ingest, sponsor detection and verified stats jobs, which call Qloo, OpenRouter, Podcast Index, Apple, podcast feeds, Spotify and Apple Podcasts Connect. Data lives in PostgreSQL and Cloudflare R2.
svg.text: One Rails 8.1 app in one Docker image, run as two processes: midrolo-web serves the site, midrolo-jobs runs Solid Queue. Everything lives in PostgreSQL.
loaded by the browser itself, never through Midrolo

g.text: rate_limit per IP and per form

svg.text: The same code runs in both processes

g.text: 7 steps, streamed live: the brand and the shows
its customers love on Qloo, catalog scores,
sponsor proof, price and trust, rank, a brief
An LLM tool loop over 8 Ruby tools: read the feed,
find on Qloo, build the audience, find, explain
and save matches. Snapshot: same tools, no LLM
Shows come from Podcast Index, Apple charts and
the paced Qloo seed. Each feed is read and its
new episodes saved and queued for a sponsor scan
An LLM reads new episodes’ notes, 10 a call; a
sponsor counts only when the notes name it
Runs the Python helper with Midrolo’s own
session, checks the show is the owner’s, then
Google email, an emailed code, or a feed token
Request a spot; accept, decline, block, report
Waitlist mode until live; a Fake twin for dev
Caps and settings, run pauses, stats sessions
Its caps and pauses gate the jobs above
Never called on a page view
